entry: HYPOTHESES L10 mesh sheet-switch audit, 20260701183124 w010-027 (2.4 um), strip-a tiles
viewing: No image, tile or CT pixel was viewed or described; CT values were streamed as numbers into 1-D normal profiles.
verdict: No whole-sheet switch in c9-c19: 0 winding-coordinate jumps (s_jumps) and normal-flip fractions <= 0.0003 in every tile, and the CT agreement matches the c0-c8 reference (median tile edge offset 0.000 vs +0.001 mm, sheet-centre offset +0.007 mm in both; IQR within +-0.015 mm). Local anomalies, 23 of 99 compared tiles flagged against the reference range: (i) self-intersections in 13/99 tiles (up to 280 pairs/tile) vs 5/81 reference tiles (max 96), concentrated in r5-r8 x c15-c19 (w012-017); (ii) close approaches to the neighbour winding in r6-r7 x c14-c15 (w017-018): 6.4-6.6 % of vertices below 0.3 of the local spacing (reference max 2.9 %), neighbour-ratio p5 0.23-0.24 (reference min 0.39). These are candidate local contact or switch sites, not a demonstrated switch; a per-vertex check (trace the CT sheet across those patches) is the next test. Offsets are reported as distributions only and do not replace p4-depth's frozen d*.
caveats: Neighbour distance is to the nearest vertex of winding k+-1 (20-vox grid), error <= ~34 um against a ~165 um spacing.

CT offsets use 40 random vertices per tile, the L0 profile over +-60 um along the vertex normal (+ = away from the umbilicus); 'edge' = max |dI/dn|, 'centre' = max I after sigma 1 vox; 12.5 % median of centre peaks sit at the window edge (a neighbour sheet or broad sheet).
Self-intersection pairs include only intersections within the tile sub-grid.
Reference = c0-c8 (known text); flags = outside the reference tiles' min-max range in the bad direction, or any self-intersection.
